text: {"lessons":["I should not treat a gain over my average cost as a reason to sell; weigh each holding’s outlook and portfolio risk instead of seeking the comfort of locking in gains.","My purchases of Stocks A and C after a decline—and again at higher prices—should follow a clear valuation and allocation plan, not an urge to average down or chase momentum.","Frequent account checks can encourage unnecessary trades; I should focus on long-term evidence, diversification, and rebalancing rather than reacting to short-term moves."]}
